title: Optimal multipolar Lp-Hardy inequalities: ground states, criticality and variational thresholds
summary: We study ground states, criticality, and variational compactness for genuinely multipolar $L^p$-Hardy weights, $1<p<n$. A ground-state representation across the poles gives a complete criticality classification of the full potential and characterizes finite-energy attainment. Removing a geometric interaction term produces a variational problem governed by concentration at the poles and infinity. A strict concentration gap yields compactness, positive extremizers, and criticality of the optimal operator; for $p\ge2$, it is also necessary for attainment.
